profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Full-Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience building mobile, web, and backend applications from the ground up.

My background includes greenfield product development, React Native mobile applications, full-stack web systems, APIs, databases, payment integrations, IoT/Bluetooth connectivity, and high-volume data workflows. 

I’ve served as the first mobile developer on a product, owned client applications from requirements through production, and worked directly with stakeholders to define scope and architecture.

I’m comfortable stepping into both new and complex environments—from launching MVPs and establishing development standards to maintaining large legacy systems, troubleshooting production issues, and improving engineering workflows.

Core technologies include React Native, React, TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase, and AWS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built and launched mobile apps from concept to App Store release and scale
• Owned product strategy, design, development, deployment, and support end to end.
• Created and executed growth strategies to drive user acquisition and retention
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · React.js · NestJS · TypeScript · Mobile Application Development · FastAPI · deepface · TensorFlow · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon S3

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the development and launch of a greenfield MVP, establishing foundational development and testing standards.  
• Developed an automated business valuation system utilizing financial APIs and market data for improved accuracy.  
• Restructured database tables to support application growth and increased client volume, ensuring scalability.  
• Standardized UI and unit testing workflows, enhancing feature validation during the development process.
positions.insights: Skills: Django REST Framework · Python (Programming Language) · AngularJS · Tailwind CSS · Next.js · React.js · Finance Apis · Software Infrastructure · Server Side JavaScript · Front-End Development · Back-End Web Development · Database Testing

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
I played a pivotal role in establishing Lion Energy's mobile application development, focusing on innovative solutions and robust architecture.  

• Played a key role in building Lion Energy's mobile apps from scratch on both iOS and Android, laying the    foundation for future app development.
• Worked directly with hardware engineers to test and connect physical devices using Bluetooth and smart IoT technology across multiple protocol levels. 
• Improved how the apps communicate with devices and added offline features so the app stays reliable even without internet access.

positions.title: Fullstack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained and extended a 15+ year-old internal legacy platform, diagnosing issues across a complex interconnected system.  
• Built and supported high-volume data pipelines, APIs, and reporting tools across multiple databases.  
• Served as the primary developer for custom applications tailored for power and water utility clients.  
• Delivered client projects from requirements through production within 1–2 month timelines, often independently.

positions.title: Computer Technician
positions.description:
• Provided Mac and Windows technical support, diagnosing and resolving software, performance, connectivity, and configuration issues.
• Managed troubleshooting and repair work across up to 6 customer computers simultaneously in a high-volume support environment.
• Handled inbound calls from customers experiencing technical issues, reconnecting remote sessions and guiding non-technical users through troubleshooting steps.
• Performed compliance verification before service began, confirming customer authorization and validating the scope of work sold.
• Communicated technical issues and solutions in clear, non-technical terms while working with customers through stressful support situations.
